title: The shroud image was made by a burst of neutrons at the resurrection

tellings.quote: The shroud is the single strangest thing on planet Earth. And it is that way because it records the moment a human being whose body had expired transformed into a being of light.

related.note: Both are about what the Shroud records of the man in it, but Strieber says it shows a body that had died and turned into light, while this telling says the man was alive.

plain: The image on the Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth many believe wrapped the body of Jesus after his death in Jerusalem, is said to have been made at the moment of resurrection, when a dead body turned into a being of light, a change linked here to a burst of neutrons. The author Whitley Strieber, known for writing about his own encounters with strange beings, puts this forward in his own words and ties it to his book given as Jesus and New Vision. He calls the shroud "the single strangest thing on planet Earth" because, he says, it "records the moment a human being whose body had expired transformed into a being of light."
